evals.name: ccxt-crypto-onboarding
evals.prompt: Wrap the `ccxt` Python library (crypto exchange market data) as a daas datasource. Build an MCP for it, register it in daas, register entities if applicable, and tell me which canonical indicators its OHLCV columns map to. ccxt is pip-installable and keyless for public market data — use the Binance exchange's fetch_ohlcv as the representative call.
evals.expected_output: A purpose-built mcp/ccxt-mcp/ with a working FastMCP server; a 'ccxt' source row in daas.db with a fetch_ohlcv function + columns (timestamp/open/high/low/close/volume); entity registration correctly skipped or noted (crypto pairs aren't stocks/countries); column_indicator_mappings showing open/high/low/close/volume auto-confirmed to canonical indicators; a usage skill at .claude/skills/ccxt-use/.

evals.name: vocabulary-extension-commodities
evals.prompt: Pre-extend the canonical indicator vocabulary for an upcoming commodities futures source. The source's tables will have columns settle_price, open_interest, and warehouse_stocks — none are in the canonical vocabulary yet. Add them to the vocabulary, then verify the mapping resolves by registering a throwaway source + a function with those three columns and running the matcher against it.
evals.expected_output: Three new rows added to references/canonical-indicators.md (settle_price, open_interest, warehouse_stocks) with sensible unit/semantic_type/aliases; setup_indicator_vocabulary.py re-run to upsert them into canonical_indicators; matcher re-run producing confirmed mappings for the three columns; no spurious canonical names invented for one-off columns.

evals.name: unrelated-domain-restraint
evals.prompt: Build a datasource from the `meteostat` Python library (weather station time series). Build the MCP, register the datasource, and map its columns to canonical indicators where they fit.
evals.expected_output: A purpose-built mcp/meteostat-mcp/; a 'meteostat' source with columns like temperature/precipitation/windspeed; the matcher leaves most weather columns UNMATCHED (they have no canonical financial/macro equivalent) and the skill correctly does NOT invent canonical names for one-off weather columns; entities skipped (weather stations aren't stocks/countries); the skill communicates that indicator mapping is sparse for this domain rather than forcing false matches.
